# Claim325 Astra high investigation

owns integration, attempt rows, commits, production sources, snapshots and all
external actions. All paths below are relative to /home/dev/Projects/EnB/.work/claim-325.
Current source revision is 5733a1a523e69ba546dfc2f6b2ba79207f182292 (retained4),

the shared-header input is rejected with target regression and pair losses.

## Evidence reviewed

Read the current instructions, brief/normal-cycle/group/Sol reports, all four
remaining targets' original complete text histories, current attempts.py show,
and actual source/replay/object/diff evidence. Inspected the successful ACK1,
ACK2, PumpConnections and CORD mechanisms and exact neighboring helpers; they
provide specific source mechanisms, not blanket permission to repeat unrelated
forms. Missing old exact sources remain unavailable. In particular bh_077's
two dead Active_.size() calls are forbidden and were not reused. The fresh
Sol Ip/Port/Session getter input was compiled and duplicates the best GoAway
body; it was not merely rejected for missing older sources.

Native extraction in astra/prior-object-inspection.json independently confirms
the actual prior best Header1187/frame350/18calls, GoAway536/frameC/14calls,
Pump combined-output trial1423/frame6E0/34calls and GetSeq68/2calls, with hashes,
references and EH. Existing project binary evidence answered the questions;
REA skill consulted, no new target/session, installation, runtime or captures.

## 0x8551F0 buildHeader

First Header batch: source-local Cord_Pop_Pending_Ack groups the existing
removeHead and successful AcksPending decrement. Exact CordCon::pump uses the
same coupled operation. This is meaningful bookkeeping, not a dead budget
spender. It tests workflow3.1.2's nested depth mechanism on the existing
Session-improved source without a header edit. All failure paths and actual
operations remain, including the previous ignored/failing list result semantics.

97b6fa1fe0720bce337014ac319ffda0aef8dfac78675382060daa94bced34aa.

1187 bytes, frame0x350, 18 calls,49 diagnostic rows; raw SHA256
f1277031e2e5024bff1e29f3037587c63d94178a574e6a548112cb312163d25c.

Exact unsigned get remains the same34-byte body/references/EH. All126/current
and original122 sets survive; all75 prior exact cordcon native bodies,
normalized references/local targets and native EH also match the control.

Second Header batch get_layer was root-approved with arraylist-header-plan.json.
Instead of adding a layer above removeHead, it places the existing getPointer
bounds/address query beneath get and then performs the same node assignment.
This differs from Sol's caller-level getPointer replacement. A generic header
body avoids explicit-specialization/ODR problems, but needs root's shared-header
scope and all-consumer proof. The exact34-byte get is an immediate control.
Generic overloaded operator& semantics must be considered for actual T users;
bounded scan of wwudp/wwonline/common found no such overload. No preservation
or helpful output was claimed before a canonical run.

TUs but imported libdefs from pristine while querying staging paths. Actual
compile.rsp consequently lacks /GX and uses pristine include roots; actual
compile.log reports C4530, missing unwind semantics. Root independently caught
the include-root issue while this already-started run finished. Astra caught
the missing /GX while inspecting its implausibly broad losses and absent EH.
The diagnostic output67 file/68 symbol pairs, Header1180/152rows/20calls and
get37bytes is not canonical source-effect evidence. Source/header inputs were
not changed to accommodate it. configuration-* files preserve its complete
objects/run/deltas/diagnostics separately. It counts as a compiled configuration
diagnostic, not another hypothesis form or failed source round. Canonical
same-input retry used root's corrected runner and new exclusive grant. The
runner now imports staging libdefs and asserts its repository root and flags
against the actual baseline response files before compilation.

TUs with /GX and staging includes. Header source SHA256
b00f90c9ea82e8168ed9030b8611c6008811633137a5d6d0528ec7d658ce67d7;

The native one-state EH/cleanup graph remains unchanged. It calls getPointer
inside BOTH ToAck and Missing expansions rather than retail's selective get
call. This confirms changed nested expansion but does not supply the required

The exact unsigned get control FAILS: its37-byte body includes an extra LEA at

After both initial meaningful helper layers were tested, the outer
coupled-operation layer duplicates
best49; the inner actual copy-accessor layer creates the wrong call boundary,

ToAck.get call while preserving first/Missing get and exact out-of-line get,
or recovered original source evidence. No automatic bool retry is justified.

Root's final review identified a distinct complete protocol operation:
kind0 ACK-record serialization (kind byte, Cord_Put_Small channel, Cord_Put_Seq
sequence). This is more substantial than the transparent dequeue/count layer
and leaves get's implementation untouched. Actual retail8554AB–85551A and the
three source statements support grouping that complete encoding block. The
shape repeats for kinds2/0/1; only kind0 changes in this proposal.
8551F0/astra/append_ack_record/ is a hash-bound Session-best source-only draft,
SHA2568caa41bf171bef7d119031a417c8bb4c244ed7b91ec379df658efaff8baf8091.
Its helper takes Active_ and i by nonconst reference (same vector operator[]),
seq by const reference, list and pos. It therefore keeps the kind store,
channel-field read/Put_Small and subsequent seq read/Put_Seq in the original
order INSIDE the helper; no prematurely evaluated field arguments. The
dequeue/count and acks/entries increments remain outside, Missing unchanged.
NAME1 identifies the inferred semantic operation; all assertion/log guards
and replay roundtrips pass. Root reviewed and approved exactly this one source
trial. Actual run runs/astra_8551F0_append_ack_record completed with the same
1187bytes/frame0x350/18calls/49rows as Session-best, raw/pattern/reference-local-
target/native-EH identical. Exact34-byte get and all75 prior exact cordcon
bodies/references/native-EH survive, as do all126 and original122 pairs in both
sets. The required selective ToAck.get call remains absent; Missing unchanged.
This is the third consecutive Header no-cut batch and ends this round. No
parameter/depth/spelling variants followed. The semantic serializer was tested,
not merely rejected for lack of historic source spelling.

## 0x8586D0 Process_Go_Away_Packet

First GoAway batch: source-local Cord_Query_Local_Address forwards the actual
connection socket query once with the same output references and bit8 result.
Retail loads the con socket receiver before argument pushes; native after.
Workflow3.1.2 file-static accessors/nested query evaluation motivate this
specific interface. It differs from the previous direct named receiver and
Ip/Port/Session field getters. The source starts from pending-case-scope23 and
preserves physical/effective assertion/log lines and all four retained gains.

Actual run runs/astra_8586D0_local_address completed. Source SHA256
6eaf47e87cebe75162359db1a252bf63207e9a0a7ec016ca9629cb418afa57a9.
Result is an exact raw/pattern duplicate of pending-case-scope23:
536 bytes, frame0xC,14 calls,23 diagnostic rows; raw SHA256
5e910310f13368226deed5acd7dad04c370c24952ffba010feed3bf6af3aa821.
The old parse/connection receiver schedule remains. All126/current and
original122 sets survive; all51 prior exact cordmgr native bodies,
normalized references/local targets and native EH also match the control.

Second batch initialized_query was root-approved and compiled. It moves the
actual lip/lport zero initialization into the query,
with output locals declared uninitialized in the caller. The query guarantees
both outputs initialized before delegation, preserving zero/write order and
the sole socket call. This changes the actual operation boundary/dataflow,
not getter spelling or width. Source SHA256
a06603e07e792d7d1c451652ac2cb084f58332ad278408f88c75c81864ed52ee.
Actual run runs/astra_8586D0_initialized_query duplicates the complete23-row
body again, including all local table targets, references/addends and native
EH. Frame/calls remain0xC/14. All126 and original122 pairs survive in both
sets. The complete query operation and the delegation-only query therefore
provide no fresh code-generation context. No getter/type/const/spelling sweep
is justified. No further supported GoAway lead identified after inspecting
the actual unchanged parse and receiver scheduling. Reopen on specific real
allocation/helper evidence explaining those instructions or reliable recovered
source. This is bounded exhaustion of useful leads, not all possible C++.

## Reproducibility and current accounting

astra/prepare.py and prepare_followups.py preserve source-bound lossless
replays and guards. Each target's astra/FORM directory contains source,
proposal.json, source.diff, completed record.json/pairs.json/objdiff.txt/
explain.json when compiled. Full input/log/object/matches/result remain in
runs/astra_ADDR_FORM. astra/analyze.py extracts actual native records with
complete pair deltas. astra/duplicate-proof.json binds local table offsets
and normalized EH labels for the two duplicates; local symbol renumbering
alone is not mistaken for a referent difference. Native cleanup/FuncInfo and
predecessors are identical; these are native diagnostic comparisons, not
claims of new retail target exactness. Every individual JSON is below64KB.

Final accounting:5 distinct canonical input tuples/5 causal batches (three Header,
two GoAway),6 runner launches including the same header tuple's initial
configuration-diagnostic launch. Eight TU compilations total:four source-local
single-TU trials plus two TUs each in the configuration and canonical header
launches. Zero compiler-invalid or semantic-invalid generated forms, guard or
tool launch failures, zero unchanged control compilations, zero uncompiled
generated proposals. Four canonical inputs duplicate their prior best complete
target bodies; one emits a distinct rejected body. Neither parked target was
compiled or generated. This is bounded exhaustion after specific source-backed
tests, not an arbitrary form quota or a claim of exhaustive C++ search.

No production/shared-source/header/snapshot/inventory/commit/GitHub mutation
outside authorized scratch/staging. Root alone owns evidence integration and
attempt rows. Compiler gate explicitly released after the completed canonical
header run and again after append_ack_record; every retained4 immutable/staging snapshot hash verified restored,
including arraylist.h. No runner/analyzer/compiler job or VM lease remains.
Remain available for root feedback. No further compilation planned.
